title: Second Portuguese–Ovimbundu War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Second Portuguese–Ovimbundu War", at revision 1370737239, opens: "The Second Portuguese–Ovimbundu War, also known as the Bailundo revolt and the National Liberation Revolt in Angola, was an armed conflict between the kingdoms of the Ovimbundu people, primarily the Bailundo kingdom, against the Portuguese Empire." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4314901, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1890–1904 rebellion in Angola". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
